mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.name, concat(u.province, u.city, u.county, u.street, u.village) AS villageAddress, u.center, g.slope_type AS slopeType, g.water_river_valley AS waterRiverValley, g.landform_feature AS landformFeature, g.stratum_lithology AS stratumLithology, g.structure_feature AS structureFeature, g.hydrogeology, g.land_vegetation AS landVegetation, g.control_structural_plane AS controlStructuralPlane, g.stability_factors AS stabilityFactors, g.stability_current AS stabilityCurrent, g.stability_trend AS stabilityTrend FROM data_slope_unit u LEFT JOIN data_slope_geology g ON g.slope_unit_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{id} ORDER BY g.id DESC LIMIT 1
